Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a SINGLE polished game inventory gift icon, prototype for a coordinated set of five Touhou spell cards. Generate exactly one square 1024x1024 RGBA icon.
Primary request: depict Reimu Hakurei's Fantasy Seal as a collectible physical spell card, with the spell's identifying motifs printed on its face.
Subject and silhouette: ONE portrait-format card, width:height about 0.66, gently rounded corners, rotated 12 degrees counterclockwise, almost front-on with just a small visible paper-card edge. Card is centered and occupies about 80 percent of the canvas height. All corners fully visible, at least 9 percent transparent margin. This simple card silhouette and border construction should be reusable for every icon in the collection.
Design: deep vermilion-red card face, a warm ivory inner field, a clean champagne-gold rim inside a bold very dark burgundy outer contour. A large RED AND WHITE yin-yang orb emblem in the middle; SIX distinct colorful luminous spirit spheres in a loose circular orbit around it, colored red, orange-gold, green, cyan, blue, violet. They are large, readable, clean illustrated circles with a bright ivory core and only restrained colored shading. A few simple red sweeping curved trails connect the visual composition. Keep all spheres and trails WITHIN the printed card face. Two or four small simple shrine-style geometric corner accents, no intricate filigree. The core emblem and spheres dominate the face, sparse ornament, no small scattered particles. Clear separation between the central yin-yang and six orbiting orbs.
Style: premium but approachable cartoon game UI item illustration. Bold clean outlines, broad legible shapes, two or three levels of cel shading, restrained small highlights. Match a cohesive inventory icon set. A paper spell card with a decorative printed border, not a bulky metal plaque. Readable at 64x64. No character portrait, no person or hands, no landscape, no mockup.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha=0 outside the single card. No background color, no checkerboard pattern, no ground shadow, no floating aura or glow outside the silhouette, no enclosing square UI tile.
Text: NONE. No readable text, pseudo-calligraphy, letters, numbers, labels, title bars, signatures, or watermarks. Show only the single finished icon, no comparison sheet.
